newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo industrial activity up 2.6 pct in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo industrial activity up 2.6 pct in Feb.

text.p: Sao Paulo state's industrial activity rose 2.6 percent in February compared with the same period the year before, the Sao Paulo state Industries Federation (Fiesp) said in a statement.
February industrial activity also rose 0.3 percent when compared to the previous month.
Industrial sales rose 2.2 percent in February against the same month in 1996, but fell 2.3 percent when compared to January 1997 figures, it added.
